screens.title: Commerce Platform · Thai/English UI Copy Review

outputComponents.text:
I have created the compact, accessible **Commerce Platform · Thai/English UI Copy Review** page (Batch `copy-1791434932312-3`).

### Key Highlights:
1. **Complete 240-Key Production Dictionary**:
   - Stored in an invisible `<script id="commerce-ui-translations" type="application/json">` dictionary.
   - Includes **exact 1:1 mapping for all 240 keys** specified in the batch without omission, truncation, or generic placeholders.
   - Natural Thai UI phrasing and natural English copy.
   - Preserves exact interpolation tokens (`{0}`, `{1}`), enums, technical identifiers (`KBANK_TESTING_CONSOLE=true`, `order.status.changed`, `X-Api-Key`), and original English spellings.
2. **Interactive Thai/English Language Switcher**:
   - Working native select (`ไทย (Thai)` / `English (US)`) that dynamically re-renders all 5 example component cards using the hidden JSON dictionary in real time, with interpolation resolution.
3. **Five Production Example Cards**:
   - **Card 1 (API & Server Credentials)**: Action button `New API key` / `คีย์ API ใหม่` and helper message `Keys authenticate your server with the X-Api-Key header. Keep them secret.`
   - **Card 2 (Catalog Image Sequence)**: Button `Next image` / `รูปถัดไป` and validation warning message `JG001_2.jpg จะทับรูปที่ 2 ของ JG001...`
   - **Card 3 (Webhook Payload Validator)**: Button `New Webhook Subscription` / `การติดตามเว็บฮุกใหม่` and helper warning `payload ไม่ใช่ JSON ที่ถูกต้อง — แก้ก่อนยิง`
   - **Card 4 (Settlement & Orders)**: Action button `Mark paid` / `ทำเครื่องหมายว่าชำระเงินแล้ว` with parameterized tokens `Oldest waiting: {0}` and `Lines ({0})`
   - **Card 5 (Integration QA Console)**: Button `Jagota Payment Testing` / `การทดสอบระบบชำระเงิน Jagota` and helper checklist description.
4. **Design Tokens & Craft**:
   - Clean slate background `#f6f8fc` with white card elevation, accent brand color `#365cf5`, and typography set to **Noto Sans Thai** + **Inter**.
   - Accessible WCAG AA contrast with semantic states.

outputComponents.suggestion: Add search & filter controls across all 240 keys in an audit table
Export translation dictionary as a downloadable JSON file
Add dark mode toggle to the review interface
